card.title: LA-5
card.flavorText: The Lavochkin La-5 was a Soviet fighter aircraft used by the Red Army in WWII. Soviet pilots considered the La-5 an effective fighter, it had a a top speed and acceleration at low altitude on par with German fighters, but did not do as well at higher altitudes. The aircraft also had its defects, there was a lack of ventilation in the cockpit and exhaust gas often entered the cockpit which forced pilots to ignore orders and fly with their canopies open. 9,920 La-5 were built, but no intact aircraft exists today.
